audit: OCOR IRB -> ADD v1.2 -> LLD v1.0 exhaustive alignment

findings.detail: 0/285 IRB requirements are individually or range-allocated by the LLD
FR-118 and FR-119 are Confirmed P0/PoC while ADD defers ELM-084 and specifies no persistent general memory
LLD supplies validation prose with fields not equal to the closed ADD CapabilityLease record, but no exact LLD data contract

findings.check: C3 idempotency binding in local atomic unit
findings.detail: DEC-201 requires aggregate revision, canonical commit, idempotency binding and outbox in one local commit
LLD preserves 44 source/destination tuples but omits the ADD transition-by-transition event/guard and durable-effect columns
LLD has no executable design for the ADD Human Gate risk classes, break-glass and emergency-stop state model
ADD deployment, isolation, backup, restore, recovery and degraded-operation prescriptions are not decomposed in the LLD
